issue.title: test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway flakes under full test-cost
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/dispatch/test_machine_bootstrap_real_gateway.py::test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway`
- **Repro:** `just check-full` (test-cost lane) then `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/dispatch/test_machine_bootstrap_real_gateway.py::test_bootstrap_issue_enroll_hello_round_trip_through_real_gateway -q --tb=short`

On 2026-09-19, sase-11l.11 landing monitor pz319b38sapt ran `just fix && just check-full && (cd sase/repos/linked/sase-core && just check)` at SHA 423316a051. test-cost failed this node with `assert status.state == "ok"` (got `"error"`) after enrollment succeeded (quarantined is False, credential present). Immediate isolated rerun on the same unchanged tree passed (1 passed in 7.46s, call 0.44s).

MachineService.status maps several hello/config failures to state `"error"` (missing alias, missing credential, or `hello failed: {code}`); the full-lane traceback did not include `status.message`, so the parallel-lane cause is unconfirmed. Not a hold/pin regression: last touch of this file is d015f48cb0; hold commits do not edit dispatch bootstrap tests. Duplicate searches (node id, real_gateway, enroll_hello, machine bootstrap) found no existing task. Active epic sase-xe.16 still has an open bootstrap-enrollment phase, but that is topical overlap, not a demonstrated causal product gap.

Evidence: file:monitor-stage:test-cost-924070-1789818373189266687-84ef1c63
